name: com.1by3.nebula
description: Middleware for dynamically meshed multiplayer game servers: Unity dedicated-server workers that hand entities to each other, an orchestrator that hosts the control plane and stores the world in SQLite or PostgreSQL, and a gateway clients connect to.

samples.description: A reference validator built on NetworkIdentity.StateAt(tick): rewind candidates to the tick a client claims, test the shot there, apply the result on the victim's authority.
